components.name: Sign Band
components.description: Charcoal sign panel with the stop roundel and the slide headline.
components.html:
04

Direct it by pointing
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; background: #1e2124; color: #fff; padding: 28px 32px; } .ds-stop { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff6319; color: #1e2124; font: 800 30px/56px 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-align: center; flex: none; } .ds-band-h { margin: 0; font: 700 48px/0.95 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Route Line
components.description: Deck progress as stops; past filled, current orange.
components.css: .ds-route { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; width: 320px; height: 20px; } .ds-route::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 3px; margin-top: -1.5px; background: #1e2124; } .ds-route li { position: relative; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e4e7e9; border: 3px solid #1e2124; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-route li.past { background: #1e2124; } .ds-route li.here { width: 18px; height: 18px; background: #ff6319; border-color: #ff6319; }

components.name: Direction Board Row
components.description: Signature: destination, detail and arrow on a charcoal sign.
components.html: PDFOne click, every slide
components.css: .ds-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr 48px; align-items: center; gap: 20px; background: #1e2124; color: #fff; padding: 18px 24px; } .ds-dest { font: 700 40px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-detail { font: 500 16px/1.3 Barlow, Arial, sans-serif; color: #b4b9be; } .ds-arrow { width: 48px; height: 48px; fill: currentColor; rotate: -90deg; }

components.name: Studio Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action in the studio top bar (Export PDF).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: #ecedee; color: #141516; border: 1px solid #ecedee; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 14px/1 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4ff3f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Studio Button
components.description: Secondary studio actions (Copy prompt for Claude).
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; background: #25262a; color: #ecedee; border: 1px solid #34363b; border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #2d2f33; border-color: #45484e; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4ff3f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Comment Pin
components.description: Numbered feedback marker on the slide canvas.
components.css: .ds-pin { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 3px; background: #d4ff3f; color: #182000; font: 700 12px/24px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pin:hover { transform: scale(1.18); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ecedee; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: Every slide is a station sign.
narrative.overview: The deck style is Platform Signage: charcoal enamel sign panels mounted on cool platform grey, condensed sign lettering, heavy arrows and a route line that tells the viewer where they are. The studio is a quiet dark tool whose one highlighter accent marks only what the owner is pointing at.
keyCharacteristics: Studio stays quiet so the slide leads

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Orange only on the roundel, the route-line stop and at most one focus element.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small tracked uppercase labels above headings; station names are set big in sentence case.

dos: Do name every meaningful element with data-el
Do put numbers in ruled tables with units
donts: Don't centre text or use gradients and glass
Don't hard-code slide numbers or pixel positions
